This Appeal, Coming On For Dismissal, This Day,
The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

When this matter was listed on 15.11.2023 before the Court, as there was no representation on behalf of both the parties, this matter was directed to be listed under the caption for dismissal on 16.11.2023.
Today, the matter is listed under the caption for dismissal.
Today also there is no representation on behalf of the appellant.
It appears that the appellant is not interested to pursue the matter.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.
